item.title: An exploratory survey model linked reported critical engagement with reported coordination and reworking of AI-assisted tasks.
item.description: AI source-checked summary (not human review; arxiv_preprint_v1). Original summary checked against the stated source by a separate AI pass; not human review or independent replication. Limited reading. Preprint, not verified peer-reviewed evidence. Source version: arxiv_preprint_v1.: An exploratory survey model linked reported critical engagement with reported coordination and reworking of AI-assisted tasks. This preprint studies a self-reported act of evaluating AI output, not improvement on an objective critical-thinking test.
